---
title: Marimo notebooks
---


## Using LMs to analyze texts

- `marimo/aat_graph.py` lets you enter a passage, analyze it with the configured LM, and visualize the resulting AAT graph. Optionally, save the analysis to a local file.
- `marimo/aat_corpus_graph.py` lets you load a corpus from a CEX file, analyze it with the configured LM, and visualize the resulting AAT graphs. Optionally, save the analyses to a local file.

## Working with results of analyses

- `marimo/aat_reader.py` lets you load saved analyses from a local file and visualize the AAT graph without any LM.
